subject: Request: Secure PR authority, CI logs & keystore rotation snapshot
messages:
From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@finbank.com>
To: sean.gallagher@redwood.example, marissa.cole@redwood.example
Cc: assessor@sigma-assess.com
Date: Tue, 02 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC2 intake: snapshot of PR authority, CI logs, and keystore rotation

Hi Sean / Marissa,

We're running an intake for FinBank's SOC 2 readiness review. Sigma has asked for a compact artifact bundle covering the secure SDLC controls for the March release (release tag: 2027-02-28). Specifically they requested:
- PR signoff matrix for sampled changes (who approved, when, and link to PR)
- CI run logs for the sampled pipeline runs producing the release artifacts
- Evidence of keystore rotation and KMS access handoff around Feb 20
- A short attestation link we can sign after reviewing artifacts

Can you assemble a zipped snapshot (redact PII and internal-only emails) and share by EOD Friday (3/5)? If you need to split items across links or provide a temporary DocuSign attestation, that works — Sigma flagged that small, clearly labeled artifacts are preferred.

Thanks,
Olivia Chen
Audit Lead, FinBank
olivia.chen@finbank.com

--

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.example>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.example, lauren.bishop@redwood.example
Date: Tue, 02 Mar 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 intake: snapshot of PR authority, CI logs, and keystore rotation

Marissa / Lauren — looping you in to assemble the requested evidence for FinBank / Sigma. Key asks from Olivia: PR signoff matrix, CI run logs for the 2027-02-28 release, and keystore rotation proof (Feb 20 window).

Marissa: can you pull the PR signoff matrix and relevant CI logs and redact any developer personal emails? Include commit SHAs.
Lauren: can you confirm what level of redaction is acceptable for keystore proofs (we usually provide operation ticket IDs + KMS rotation audit entries but redact KMS principal ARNs).

Target: share initial bundle or Drive folder link by EOD Fri 3/5. If this looks like it will slip, tell me by Thursday close of business and we'll request a one-day extension.

Thanks,
Sean
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.example>
To: sean.gallagher@redwood.example, lauren.bishop@redwood.example
Cc: olivia.chen@finbank.com, assessor@sigma-assess.com
Date: Wed, 03 Mar 2027 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 intake: snapshot of PR authority, CI logs, and keystore rotation

Sean / Lauren / Olivia — attaching the first pass. I've collected and staged the following artifacts in the shared evidence folder (links below and attachments stubbed):

Inventory (staged):
- pr_signoff_matrix_20270228.csv (matrix with PR links, approver usernames, approval timestamps, and brief justification)
- ci_run_20270228.log (trimmed pipeline logs showing successful build/test steps; sensitive env vars redacted)
- keystore_rotation_proof_20270220.pdf (redacted ops ticket and KMS audit snapshot; principal ARNs removed)
- commit_shas_20270228.txt (list of commit SHAs included in the release)

Notes on redaction:
- Developer emails replaced with username handles (e.g., jdoe -> jdoe) and hashed IDs where required.
- Build artifacts and binaries are not included; just the pipeline logs and checksums.
- Keystore proof includes ticket ID SK-4521 and rotation start/end timestamps; the KMS audit export is redacted to remove full ARNs but retains key rotation event IDs and timestamps.

Links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD_example_shared_evidence

I attached small stubs with filenames in case Sigma prefers attachments in the thread. If you want the full log file, I can provide a time-limited signed URL.

Marissa Cole
Senior Security Analyst, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.example

--
Attachments included: pr_signoff_matrix_20270228.csv; ci_run_20270228.log; keystore_rotation_proof_20270220.pdf; commit_shas_20270228.txt

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.example>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.example, sean.gallagher@redwood.example
Date: Thu, 04 Mar 2027 11:16:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 intake: snapshot of PR authority, CI logs, and keystore rotation

Thanks Marissa — this looks good. A couple quick clarifications before we hand over the full bundle to Sigma: 

1) Redaction level for keystore audit: acceptable to provide event IDs + timestamps + ticket references. Do not include any full KMS key aliases or ARNs. Confirmed: please keep as-is.
2) PR matrix: Sigma asked for approver role, not necessarily full name. Can you add an additional column 'approver_role' (e.g., engineering-lead, security-review) and replace any personal notes in the justification column with short, factual statements.
3) CI logs: trim the first 20 lines of bootstrap noise and leave the test failure/success exit codes and checksums. Provide a signed short-URL for the full log if requested.

If you make those edits, I can sign off and we can send Olivia both the Drive folder and a zipped bundle. Also confirm whether we should include the ephemeral deploy keys rotation note (we rotated ephemeral deploy keys on 2027-02-25) — Sigma might want context.

Lauren Bishop
Manager, Compliance & Controls
lauren.bishop@redwood.example

--

At that point we'll send a short DocuSign attestation to the contact on file. Please use this link to upload the final zipped bundle or set a Drive permission for assessor@sigma-assess.com: https://app.docusign.com/prepare/3bC9-example-attestation

Two minor asks:
- If possible include the ephemeral deploy key rotation note (2027-02-25) in keystore_rotation_proof_20270220.pdf as an appendix.
- Please include the mapping between PR IDs and commit SHAs in the CSV (single column with SHA).

I'll watch for the update today.

Best,
